kinds.label: X / Twitter data
kinds.fallback: tell the user; never fake it with web search

kinds.label: long video/audio, documents far beyond ~200 pages
live web, fact check, versions, prices
kinds.fallback: agent:general-purpose sonnet medium with WebSearch; judging the findings stays deep's

kinds.label: compare, evaluate, find gaps, diagnose why, review a codebase or a design, recommend, formal writing
kinds.keep_if: the material is small (a few files, under ~200 lines, a short text): say so in the line

kinds.label: a change that needs an architecture, public interface, data-format or cross-module decision the user did not make
changed code beyond one file where the goal is clear, or a bug with a failing test (Haiku coder first, Sonnet after a failed check); layout, naming and file choice are the coder's
the answer is already in a file here, a command's output or your own knowledge; a one-file edit

planner.xhigh: architecture, wide blast radius, real trade-offs

deep.medium: ordinary verdicts: a diagnosis within one file, a comparison of two small things, a review of a small diff
deep.high: hard problems, multi-file debugging, first drafts of formal writing
deep.xhigh: key decisions, final drafts, money or law
deep.max: only when the user says "extremely important"

phrases.judgement: judgement words ({t}) -> size the material: small -> you, with a `Kept:` line; large or high-stakes -> Agent(deep)
phrases.review: review words ({t}) -> the review lane for a diff, else Agent(deep)
phrases.design: design words ({t}) -> Agent(planner) before any coder
phrases.code: edit words ({t}) -> Agent(coder) once nothing is left to decide
phrases.web: web signs ({t}) -> the search lane fetches, judging what it finds is still deep's

checklist.title: [spick triage - answer all three before any tool call]
checklist.plan: 1. Plan mode? 3+ files, irreversible or wide action, ambiguous ask, new build, or a requested plan -> EnterPlanMode, then planner inside it (headless: plan inline, stop before editing unless told to go ahead).
checklist.lane_head: 2. Lane? Route by the deliverable's shape, top to bottom, first match wins:

bullets.name: LANES
bullets.builtin: - X data -> Grok; images -> Codex; long media, live web, facts -> Gemini (agy).
bullets.registry: - an outside lane's task -> the Lanes line, by tag; never above its data: level.
bullets.none: - no outside lane is enabled: do not call Gemini, Grok or Codex; live web -> Agent(general-purpose, sonnet) with WebSearch; X data, images -> tell the user.

bullets.name: DEEP
bullets.text: - a verdict (compare, evaluate, diagnose, review, recommend, formal writing): small material (a few files, under ~200 lines) -> you, with a `Kept:` line; large material, high stakes, a second failure or unsure -> Agent(deep).

bullets.name: PLANNER
bullets.text: - a decision the user did not make (architecture, public interface, data format, cross-module trade-off) -> Agent(planner), then Agent(coder).

bullets.name: CODER
bullets.text: - code beyond one file, goal clear -> Agent(coder); a bug with a failing test -> Agent(coder, model haiku) first, the test is the check; still failing -> Agent(coder) at high. Layout and naming are its calls.

bullets.name: REVIEW
bullets.builtin: - a diff to review -> Codex, else Agent(deep).
bullets.registry: - a diff to review -> the lane tagged review, else Agent(deep).

bullets.name: YOU
bullets.text: - the answer is in a file, a command's output or your knowledge, or a one-file edit -> you; a kept verdict needs a `Kept:` line.

checklist.tail: A prompt that mixes kinds is split by kind. Effort for every delegate. A brief is a handoff packet, not your trail; one saying how is a design: planner. A check failing twice: Agent(coder) at high, or Agent(deep) if the cause is unknown.
checklist.goal: 3. Goal-shaped? A machine-checkable finish (tests, build, exit 0) needing several edit-run cycles -> hand the user one `/goal <check command>; stop after 10 attempts` line.
checklist.label: Reply starts with the deliverable; end with the label line: no delegate -> `[Model: {main} | Effort: medium]`; with delegates -> `[Model: {main} (medium) → coder Sonnet 5.5 (high) | {review}]` — {who}.
checklist.who_with_reviewer: every participant carries its own model and effort
checklist.who_plain: every participant carries its own model and effort
